entries.02cb31ad25f02ce7: Under its management philosophy "Good for people, good for society, good for the future," and as the first year of the "Second Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2025–2027)," the company aims for continued growth through the "evolution" of the food business and the "deepening" of the oil and fat chemicals business, making use of the growth base of the businesses built under the previous medium-term management plan.
entries.03affe8314aa5f11: It has a business structure that handles materials for both edible processed oils and fats and industrial oils and fats and chemicals, using natural oils and fats as raw materials. It is advancing new product development using its proprietary technologies and offers product lines that reflect market needs, including the 'botanova' plant-based food series under its own brand and products responding to higher cacao prices and soaring rice and egg prices. It has manufacturing sites in Chiba, Kobe and Nagoya, and it also conducts a chocolate fat business through a joint venture with ＡＡＫ of Sweden.

entries.10ae6375423a99fc: Under its management philosophy "Good for people, good for society, good for the future," in the first year of the "Second Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027)," it aims for continued growth through the "evolution" of the Food Business and the "deepening" of the Oleochemical Business, making use of the business growth base built in the previous medium-term management plan. It states that it is working on optimizing selling prices, expanding sales centered on main products, developing products that incorporate market needs, renewing production facilities and building production systems at each manufacturing site, and improving operational efficiency and promoting DX toward the renewal of its core system.

entries.16fdea0fdd932b66: The company group has two reportable segments, the Food Business and the Oleochemicals Business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥59,474 million. Revenue from external customers by segment is ¥42,093 million for the Food Business, ¥16,904 million for the Oleochemicals Business, and ¥476 million for other (real estate leasing, raw oils and fats, etc.). Regional information is omitted because revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue. Information by major customer prints revenue of ¥6,901 million from Nisshin Tōa Iwao Co., Ltd. Related party information prints product sales to Yamazaki Baking Co., Ltd., a major shareholder, in a form that includes sales to Nisshin Tōa Iwao Co., Ltd. and 12 other trading companies that transact with it.
